implemented: Repaired the AST-driven visibility primitive `has_public_modifier` (crates/tldr-cli/src/commands/patterns/interface.rs) so it returns false when an explicit private/protected/internal (C# also `file`) access-modifier child is present, while preserving implicit-public for members carrying NO access keyword (Java/C#/PHP interface & enum members). The legacy fall-through returned true unconditionally whenever no `public` keyword was seen, so explicit private/protected/internal members leaked into the public `methods` set and private_method_count was always 0 for csharp/java/php. Factored the logic into a new AST-driven helper `explicit_access_visibility(node)` -> Option<bool> that recognises every grammar shape by NODE KIND (no source-text scan): Java `modifiers` wrapper with anonymous keyword-token children; C# individual `modifier` children; PHP direct `visibility_modifier` child; TS `accessibility_modifier`. Routed PHP (previously fell through to `_ => true`) onto the same shared predicate in `is_method_public` alongside Java/C#. The `_ => true` arm (covering C/Cpp/Kotlin/Swift/Elixir/OCaml) was preserved, not deleted.

A single-language fix cannot pass this gate.
